description: Population-level treatment-evidence landscape for one treatment modality of one sleep-disorder condition. Aggregates constituent evidenceRecords (G1 provenance preserved), carries an explicit overall GRADE (G2), a mandatory non-diagnostic disclaimer reference (G3, via suimin_disclaimer_gate), and a referral pointer (G4). NEVER individual-specific: no diagnosis, severity (AHI), device setting, surgical indication, or prescription (N1-N5). Per ADR-2606072800 §Decision 5 (suimin_treatment_synthesize).

treatmentDisplayName.description: Brand-neutral name (device class / INN only — G12), e.g., 'CPAP (持続陽圧呼吸療法)'.

overallEvidenceGrade.description: GRADE summary across constituent evidence (G2). Mandatory.

populationSummary.description: Population-level synthesis: what the evidence shows for the general condition population (efficacy on AHI / daytime sleepiness / cardiovascular outcomes / adherence). NOT a recommendation for any individual (G4).

considerations.description: Brand-neutral considerations (e.g., adherence challenges, candidacy generally discussed in guidelines). Framed as 'discuss with a sleep-medicine clinician', not a directive.

evidenceRecordUris.description: Back-references to constituent com.etzhayyim.suimin.evidenceRecord items (G1 provenance chain). At least one required — no claim without evidence.

disclaimerTextUri.description: Reference to the active com.etzhayyim.suimin.disclaimerText (G3 invariant — set by suimin_disclaimer_gate, tamper-resistant).

referralPathwayUri.description: Optional pointer to com.etzhayyim.suimin.referralPathway (G4 — where to seek a clinician).

mdReviewWitnessDid.description: R2+ licensed sleep-medicine MD co-sign DID (G9 witness N>=2 for synthesis baseline).

phase.description: Phasing gate (ADR-2606072800 §Decision 7). R1 = corpus-level only (no PHI).
